rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for being in a state of sleep.

example.jyutping: go3 zai2 ji5 ging1 fan3 zoek6 laa3

rows.note: Use this for a body part that has gone numb or prickly from pressure.
Use this when “asleep” means inattentive rather than literally sleeping.

example.english: You’re asleep in class—you can’t even hear the teacher calling you.
example.traditional: 你上堂唔專心，老師叫你都聽唔到。
example.jyutping: nei5 soeng6 tong4 m4 zyun1 sam1 lou5 si1 giu3 nei5 dou1 teng1 m4 dou2
